title: Credit Fairness: Online Fairness In Shared Resource Pools
abstract: arXiv:2601.17944v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study repeated allocation of shared resources among agents with time-varying demands and capped linear utilities. In this setting, independently maximizing the minimum endowment-normalized utility in each round satisfies sharing incentives (agents weakly prefer participating in the mechanism to not participating), strategyproofness (agents have no incentive to misreport their demands), and Pareto efficiency. However, this max-min mechanism can lead to large disparities in the total resources received by agents, even when they have the same average demand. We introduce credit fairness, a property that, together with Pareto efficiency, strengthens sharing incentives by giving agents who lend resources in early rounds priority toward recouping those resources in later rounds. translated_title: 信用公平：共享资源池中的在线公平性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.17944v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们研究了在具有时变需求和上限线性效用的代理之间重复分配共享资源的问题。在这种设置下，每轮独立地最大化最小禀赋归一化效用满足共享激励（代理弱偏好参与机制而非不参与）、策略证明性（代理没有动机虚报其需求）和帕累托效率。然而，这种最大最小机制可能导致代理获得的总资源存在巨大差异，即使他们的平均需求相同。我们引入了信用公平这一属性，它与帕累托效率一起，通过给予在早期轮次中借出资源的代理在后续轮次中优先回收这些资源的权利，从而加强了共享激励。信用公平可以单独与帕累托效率或策略证明性结合实现，但我们表明，在匿名性条件下，它无法同时与两者兼容。
tldr: 本文提出信用公平属性，通过赋予早期借出资源的代理优先回收权，在共享资源池中加强公平性，但证明在匿名性下无法同时兼顾帕累托效率和策略证明性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces credit fairness, which grants priority to agents who lend resources early for later recovery, strengthening fairness in shared resource pools, but shows it cannot be combined with both Pareto efficiency and strategyproofness under anonymity.
